hook_text: Three buckets of soil, one vegetable garden. Which soil would you choose?
clip_script: Giyani, Limpopo. Bucket one: sand from the riverbed. Gritty, big grains, water whooshes straight through. Bucket two: clay from the dam. Sticky, tiny grains, holds water, cracks when dry. Bucket three: dark, crumbly loam. A mix of sand, silt, clay and humus. Drop soil in water: bubbles of air! Pour water through funnels: sand fastest, clay slowest. The winner for spinach and tomatoes? Loam!
visual_style: Whiteboard with three funnels dripping water into jugs, and a settling jar with labelled layers.
mood: Playful competition, like a cooking show judging three dishes.
pacing: Three quick contestants, two tests, one winner.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and test the soil in your own garden.
